title: A Shepherd in the Wilderness
text: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian.

title: Horeb
text: He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

title: Ablaze but Not Consumed
text: Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.

title: A Marvelous Sight
text: I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?

title: Here I Am
text: “Moses, Moses!” “Here I am,” he answered.

title: Holy Ground
text: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

title: The God of Abraham
text: I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

title: I Have Seen
text: I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt.

title: To Rescue Them
text: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians …

title: I Am Sending You
text: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.

title: Who Am I?
text: Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?

title: I Will Be with You
text: I will surely be with you …

title: I AM WHO I AM
text: I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’

title: My Name Forever
text: This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.

title: What Is in Your Hand?
text: What is that in your hand?

title: Slow of Speech
text: I am slow of speech and tongue.

title: Who Gave Man His Mouth?
text: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.

title: Aaron
text: Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well …

title: Aaron Met Moses
text: So he went and met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.

title: They Believed
text: And Moses performed the signs before the people, and they believed.

title: Zipporah
text: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.

title: They Bowed Down and Worshiped
text: … they bowed down and worshiped.
